brief:
Israel imposed sweeping closures across the occupied West Bank following a deadly attack on its soldiers in Hebron, prompting the United Nations to express alarm at intensifying violence in the territory, UN News reported Friday.

The UN said it was "extremely alarmed" by the escalating violence as Israeli forces moved to seal off the West Bank in response to the incident.
dek: The UN said on Friday it was “extremely alarmed” by intensifying violence in the occupied West Bank, as Israel moved to seal off the territory following a deadly attack on its soldiers in Hebron.
title: Israel seals West Bank after deadly Hebron attack, UN warns
